family: Cfl1 cysteine-rich adhesin family (basidiomycete-specific SIGC/chitin-binding domain)
adhesion_quote: A sharp increase in cell aggregation was observed when P CTR4-2-CFL1 cells were cultured under promoter-inducing conditions.
evidence_summary: Cfl1 is a secreted cysteine-rich cell-surface protein characterized as the first basidiomycete adhesin. CFL1 overexpression increased cell aggregation/flocculation, CFL1 deletion reduced hyphae and biofilm, and secretion was required for cell adhesion (also PMID 23798436: released Cfl1 acts as a paracrine adhesion signal driving biofilm colonies).
mechanism_label: other (novel basidiomycete-specific cysteine-rich adhesin, SIGC domain; no tandem repeats reported)
mechanism_quote: Cfl1, a Znf2 downstream factor, regulates morphogenesis, cell adhesion, biofilm formation, and virulence. Cfl1 is the first adhesin discovered in the phylum Basidiomycota.

adhesion_quote: In contrast, CAP67 adhesion was only inhibited in the presence of MP84. These results demonstrate the involvement of MP in the adhesion of C. neoformans to epithelial lung cells.
evidence_summary: Recombinant MP84 (chitin deacetylase 3) expressed on P. pastoris bound A549 lung epithelial cells and specifically inhibited adhesion of the GXM-deficient CAP67 strain, showing this mannoprotein mediates Cryptococcus adhesion to epithelial lung cells.
mechanism_label: 2d (moonlighting; chitin-deacetylase wall enzyme that also mediates host-cell adhesion)
mechanism_quote: MP84, a mannoprotein with molecular weight of 84 kDa... CAP67 adhesion was only inhibited in the presence of MP84.

adhesion_quote: Here we show that BcLysM1 is required for mycelial adhesion to hydrophobic surfaces, including bean leaves, but it is dispensable for conidial adhesion.
evidence_summary: Deletion + complementation + purified recombinant protein. BcLysM1 binds chitin in the fungal cell wall and protects hyphae from chitinases; its deletion reduces mycelial adhesion to bean-leaf and hydrophobic (polystyrene) surfaces and is restored by complementation.
mechanism_label: other (LysM-domain chitin-binding effector mediating cell-wall/interface adhesion)
mechanism_quote: BcLysM1 is required for mycelial adhesion to hydrophobic surfaces, including bean leaves.

adhesion_quote: adhesion of P. marneffei conidia to fibronectin and laminin was inhibited by rGAPDH or rabbit anti-rGAPDH serum in a dose-dependent manner.
evidence_summary: Extracellular proteomics of the dimorphic fungus identified GAPDH as an adherence factor. Purified recombinant GAPDH and anti-GAPDH serum dose-dependently inhibited conidial adhesion to fibronectin, laminin and A549 pneumocytes.
mechanism_label: 2d (moonlighting metabolic enzyme with host-ECM/pneumocyte adhesive activity)
mechanism_quote: glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase as an important adhesion factor for conidial attachment.

family: integrin-like ECM adhesion receptor (RGD + MIDAS motifs); not the MSG family
adhesion_quote: Heterologous expression of PCINT1 in yeast followed by application to human fibronectin-coated surfaces... gain the ability to bind fibronectin in a cation dependent fashion.
evidence_summary: Heterologous expression of PCINT1 in yeast conferred cation-dependent binding to human fibronectin-coated surfaces; the protein carries an internal RGD motif and four metal-ion-dependent attachment (MIDAS) sites. A distinct Pneumocystis adhesion receptor apart from the MSG family.
mechanism_quote: PCINT1, a molecule with integrin-like features that mediates organism adhesion to fibronectin.

adhesion_quote: Yps3p released into the G217B culture supernatant binds to the surface of strains that do not naturally express the protein. This binding was saturable... consistent with Yps3p binding to chitin.
evidence_summary: Yps3p is a yeast-phase cell-wall protein also released into the medium; purified/secreted Yps3p bound saturably to fungal cell surfaces and specifically to chitin (not cellulose). E2: binding to a fungal cell-wall polysaccharide and cell surfaces, not shown to bind host cells.
mechanism_label: other (yeast-phase cell-wall protein binding fungal chitin/cell surface)
mechanism_quote: The cell wall fraction of Yps3p was surface localized... Yps3p binding to chitin.

adhesion_quote: We conclude that Lep1 acts as a novel kind of cell adhesin which functions together with other surface-active proteins.
evidence_summary: lepl deletion mutants show attenuated hyphal aggregation in maize tumors and produce few spores; constitutive expression induces cell aggregation and enhanced surface hydrophobicity; Lep1 localizes to the cell wall of biotrophic hyphae and associates with Rep1.
mechanism_label: other (novel small secreted effector adhesin; not repeat/CFEM/hydrophobin)
mechanism_quote: Lep1 is bound to the cell wall of biotrophic hyphae... acts as a novel kind of cell adhesin.

adhesion_quote: dFghyd3 and the triple mutant dFghyd234 were also affected in the attachment to hydrophobic surface... FgHyd3 is necessary for hydrophobic surface attachment.
evidence_summary: Targeted deletion of the class I hydrophobin FgHyd3 reduces attachment of germlings/hyphae to hydrophobic surfaces; single and triple mutants show defective attachment, and mutants show reduced adhesion of conidia to wheat spikes during early infection.
mechanism_quote: Different Hydrophobins of Fusarium graminearum... attachment to hydrophobic surfaces.
